words.gloss: endowed with character, strength, health and spirit

hindi: जनपदवासी, कुलीन, उत्तम संयम वाला, किए हुए शिल्प वाला, चक्षुष्मान्, प्राज्ञ, धारणशील, दक्ष, वाग्मी, प्रगल्भ, प्रतिपत्तिमान्, उत्साह और प्रभाव से युक्त, क्लेश सहने वाला, शुचि, मैत्रीपूर्ण, दृढ़ भक्ति वाला, शील, बल, आरोग्य, सत्त्व से युक्त, अकड़ और चंचलता से रहित, सम्प्रिय, वैरों का अकर्ता — यह अमात्य की सम्पत् है।
english: Country person, well-born, of good restraint, with skill made, possessed of eyes, wise, retentive, dexterous, eloquent, bold, possessed of grasp, endowed with energy and might, bearing hardship, pure, friendly, of firm devotion, endowed with character, strength, health and spirit, devoid of stiffness and fickleness, thoroughly agreeable, a non-maker of enmities — Such is the excellence of the minister.
notes: A verbless list of qualities closed by iti and the label amātya-sampat (glossary: sampat = excellence of X; label 'Such is X', iti = closing particle). jānapada = a person of the country (glossary: country people); the first quality is not 'native' in a stronger sense. svavagraha: printed as one word; sandhi su+a gives sva, so read su-avagrahaḥ 'of good restraint' (avagraha = restraint, as in unit 3); the alternative sva-avagraha would be written svāv-, so it is not adopted; sense of the whole (self-restraint, or 'easily restrained') is uncertain. kṛta-śilpa: literally 'one by whom skill is made'; read 'with skill acquired'. cakṣuṣmān: literally 'having eyes'; unit 3 shows the fuller 'treatise-eye' (śāstra-cakṣuṣmattā), not imported here. dhārayiṣṇu: literally 'holding'; 'retentive' follows dhārayiṣṇutā of unit 3. pratipattimān: pratipatti is left as 'grasp' (alternatives: understanding, presence of mind). stambha = stiffness (alternative: obstinacy, pride); cāpala = fickleness. sampriya: 'sam' read as 'thoroughly'. vairāṇām akartā: literally 'a non-maker of enmities'. Reviewer: kṛta-śilpa rendered literally 'with skill made'; the sense 'trained, skilled' (acquired) is the likely meaning but is not stated in the word.
lines_deva: जानपदो अभिजातः स्ववग्रहः कृत.शिल्पश् चक्षुष्मान् प्राज्ञो धारयिष्णुर् दक्षो वाग्मी प्रगल्भः प्रतिपत्तिमान् उत्साह.प्रभाव.युक्तः क्लेश.सहः शुचिर् मैत्रो दृढ.भक्तिः शील.बल.आरोग्य.सत्त्व.युक्तः स्तम्भ.चापल.हीनः सम्प्रियो वैराणाम् अकर्ता-इत्य् अमात्य.सम्पत्
lines_iast: jānapado abhijātaḥ svavagrahaḥ kṛta.śilpaś cakṣuṣmān prājño dhārayiṣṇur dakṣo vāgmī pragalbhaḥ pratipattimān utsāha.prabhāva.yuktaḥ kleśa.sahaḥ śucir maitro dṛḍha.bhaktiḥ śīla.bala.ārogya.sattva.yuktaḥ stambha.cāpala.hīnaḥ sampriyo vairāṇām akartā-ity amātya.sampat

words.gloss: lacking a quarter and a half of the qualities

hindi: इससे चौथाई और आधे गुणों से हीन दोनों मध्यम और निम्न।
english: From this, the two lacking a quarter and a half of the qualities [are] the middle and the lower.

text_flags.why: argha ('price') gives no sense here; ardha ('half') is the word wanted, as the pair 'quarter and half' of the qualities

notes: Verbless clause. ataḥ read 'from this' (the standard of unit 1; ablative of comparison). The text does not say which deficiency belongs to which grade (quarter to the middle, half to the lower is the natural pairing, not stated). avara = lower (not 'lowest'). Dual forms throughout.

words.gloss: from those of the same learning
connection with character, strength, health and spirit

hindi: उनके जनपद, कुल, संयम की परीक्षा विश्वसनीय से करे; समान विद्या वालों से शिल्प और शास्त्र-चक्षुष्मत्ता; कर्मों के आरम्भों में प्रज्ञा, धारणशीलता, दक्षता; वार्तालाप के प्रसंगों में वाग्मित्व, प्रगल्भता, प्रतिभानवत्त्व; साथ रहने वालों से शील, बल, आरोग्य, सत्त्व का जुड़ाव, अकड़ का अभाव, चंचलता का अभाव; प्रत्यक्षतः सम्प्रियत्व और अवैरत्व।
english: Their country, high birth and restraint [one] should examine from the reliable; [examine] skill and being possessed of the treatise-eye from [those] of the same learning; [examine] in the commencements of works insight, retentiveness and dexterity; [examine] in the occasions of conversation eloquence, boldness and being possessed of pratibhāna (ready wit); [examine] from co-dwellers connection with character, strength, health and spirit, the absence of stiffness and the absence of fickleness; [examine] directly thorough agreeableness and non-enmity.

text_flags.why: possible clipped final vowel: the first member of the compound should be janapada (cf. janapada, not janapad)

notes: parīkṣeta governs every segment; after the first it is understood (bracketed in English, not repeated in Hindi). teṣām read as 'their' (of the candidate ministers of unit 1-2). The qualities examined correspond to those of unit 1. abhijana = high birth (glossary); avagraha = restraint (cf. su-avagraha in unit 1). samāna-vidya: 'of the same learning' (fellow students); āptataḥ is the -tas suffix, 'from the reliable'. kathā-yoga: yoga is literally 'connection'; 'occasions of conversation' is the rendering chosen, 'engagements/contacts of talk' possible. pratibhāna (ready wit; literally 'shining forth') kept as a term. saṃvāsin = one who lives together. yoga in śīla-...-sattva-yogam = connection. pratyakṣataḥ read 'directly'. Several three-member lists close with ca: Hindi uses commas only.
lines_deva: तेषां जनपद्.अभिजनम् अवग्रहं च-आप्ततः परीक्षेत, समान.विद्येभ्यः शिल्पं शास्त्र.चक्षुष्मत्तां च, कर्म.आरम्भेषु प्रज्ञां धारयिष्णुतां दाक्ष्यं च, कथा.योगेषु वाग्मित्वं प्रागल्भ्यं प्रतिभानवत्त्वं च, संवासिभ्यः शील.बल.आरोग्य.सत्त्व.योगम् अस्तम्भम् अचापलं च, प्रत्यक्षतः सम्प्रियत्वम् अवैरत्वं च
lines_iast: teṣāṃ janapad.abhijanam avagrahaṃ ca-āptataḥ parīkṣeta, samāna.vidyebhyaḥ śilpaṃ śāstra.cakṣuṣmattāṃ ca, karma.ārambheṣu prajñāṃ dhārayiṣṇutāṃ dākṣyaṃ ca, kathā.yogeṣu vāgmitvaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ pratibhānavattvaṃ ca, saṃvāsibhyaḥ śīla.bala.ārogya.sattva.yogam astambham acāpalaṃ ca, pratyakṣataḥ sampriyatvam avairatvaṃ ca

words.gloss: direct, indirect and to be inferred

hindi: क्योंकि राजा की वृत्ति प्रत्यक्ष, परोक्ष, अनुमेय।
english: For the king's conduct [is] direct, indirect and to be inferred.
notes: Verbless clause. vṛtti = conduct (cf. nyāya-vṛtti 'just conduct'); the compound pratyakṣa-parokṣa-anumeyā is read as a three-member dvandva in the feminine agreeing with vṛttiḥ. Units 5-7 define the three terms.

text_flags.why: stray letters: vowel ṛ written as dr; the word is dṛṣṭam

notes: Verbless clause; a definition of pratyakṣa.
Verbless clause; a definition of parokṣa. upadiṣṭa = pointed out (taught, told).

hindi: कर्मों में किए हुए से न किए हुए का अवलोकन अनुमेय।
english: In works, the viewing of the not done by the done [is] to be inferred.
notes: Verbless clause; a definition of anumeya. akṛta-avekṣaṇa is read 'viewing of the not done' (tat-puruṣa), kṛtena 'by the done'; i.e. from what has been done one looks at what has not been done. karma = works.

words.gloss: because of being situated in many

hindi: किन्तु कर्मों के एक साथ होने, अनेक होने, अनेक में स्थित होने के कारण “देश और काल का अत्यय न हो”, परोक्ष अमात्यों से करवाए। — यह अमात्यों का कर्म है।
english: But because of the simultaneity of works, [their] multiplicity and [their] being situated in many [places], “let there be no lapse of place and time”: [one] should have [it] done indirectly through ministers. — Such is the work of ministers.

text_flags.why: embedded verse number and bars inside the unit line; not Sanskrit words

notes: GROUPING: the printed '| 8 |' is an embedded verse number plus separators inside the unit; the closing label 'iti amātya-karma' follows it and belongs to the section, not to the sentence. The number is not rendered. iti after mā bhūt closes the quoted purpose-clause (carried by the quotation marks, no 'thus'); no opening quote is printed. deśa = place; atyaya = lapse (literally 'passing beyond'), the Hindi keeps अत्यय. anekastha = 'standing in many' (places is understood, bracketed in English only). parokṣam read adverbially 'indirectly' (cf. unit 6); kārayet 'should have (it) done', object unstated. karma = works; in the label amātya-karma 'work of ministers' (number of amātya uncertain).
lines_deva: यौगपद्यात् तु कर्मणाम् अनेकत्वाद् अनेकस्थत्वाच् च देश.काल.अत्ययो मा भूद् इति परोक्षम् अमात्यैः कारयेत् । ८ । इत्य् अमात्य.कर्म
lines_iast: yaugapadyāt tu karmaṇām anekatvād anekasthatvāc ca deśa.kāla.atyayo mā bhūd iti parokṣam amātyaiḥ kārayet | 8 | ity amātya.karma

hindi: पुरोहित बनाए — उदित-उदित कुल और शील वाले, अङ्गों सहित वेद में, दैव निमित्त में, दण्डनीति में प्रशिक्षित, दैव और मानुष आपत्तियों के अथर्वों और उपायों द्वारा प्रतिकार करने वाले।
english: [One] should make a chaplain — of risen-risen family and character, trained in the Veda with its limbs, in the divine omen and in the policy of punishment, a counteracter of adversities, divine and human, by the Atharvans and by means.
notes: purohita = chaplain (glossary 7.15). udita-udita is literally 'risen-risen' (commonly 'exalted'); kept literal. daive nimitte read as one phrase 'in the divine omen' (both neuter locative singular); alternative: daive and nimitte as two separate items. atharvabhiḥ is the printed form (instrumental plural); it is read 'by the Atharvans' so that ca joins it to upāyaiḥ 'by means'; the usual reading 'by Atharvan means' is an alternative, low-to-medium confidence. daiva-mānuṣīṇām agrees with āpadām (glossary: āpad = adversity). pratikartṛ = counteracter (cf. pratikurvīta, pratikāra). Hindi list of three locatives closed by ca takes commas only.
lines_deva: पुरोहितम् उदित.उदित.कुल.शीलं स-अङ्गे वेदे दैवे निमित्ते दण्ड.नीत्यां च-अभिविनीतम् आपदां दैव.मानुषीणाम् अथर्वभिर् उपायैश् च प्रतिकर्तारं कुर्वीत
lines_iast: purohitam udita.udita.kula.śīlaṃ sa-aṅge vede daive nimitte daṇḍa.nītyāṃ ca-abhivinītam āpadāṃ daiva.mānuṣīṇām atharvabhir upāyaiś ca pratikartāraṃ kurvīta

hindi: उसका अनुसरण करे, जैसे शिष्य आचार्य का, पुत्र पिता का, सेवक स्वामी का।
english: [One] should follow him as a pupil [follows] a teacher, a son a father and a servant a master.
notes: tam refers to the chaplain of unit 9. The verb is supplied in brackets in English only. The ca after iva closes the list of three comparisons (Hindi commas only, as in 1.2). anuvarteta = should follow (conform to).
lines_deva: तम् आचार्यं शिष्यः पितरं पुत्रो भृत्यः स्वामिनम् इव च-अनुवर्तेत
lines_iast: tam ācāryaṃ śiṣyaḥ pitaraṃ putro bhṛtyaḥ svāminam iva ca-anuvarteta

words.gloss: consecrated by the counsel of the counsellor
armed by following of the treatise

hindi: ब्राह्मण द्वारा समृद्ध किया गया क्षत्र, मन्त्री के मन्त्र से अभिमन्त्रित, अजित को पूरी तरह जीतता है, शास्त्र के अनुगमन से शस्त्रित।
english: The kṣatra (ruling power), made to prosper by a brāhmaṇa, consecrated by the counsel of the counsellor, conquers the unconquered utterly, armed by the following of the treatise.
notes: A verse (two lines of 16 syllables). Wordplay: mantra is both 'counsel' and 'spell', abhimantrita 'consecrated'; śastrita is 'made weaponed' from śastra. kṣatra = ruling power (the warrior/ruling order is the alternative). edhita = made to prosper (grown). atyantam read 'utterly'. The participles are read as qualifying kṣatram; ajitam is the object of jayati.
